items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: It was Burt and I playing. It was Burt Bacarach and I, yeah.

ctx.x: Wait a minute now. Are you the guy that played [scats]. On “This Guy’s In Love with You” on the record?
Well there were two pianos. It was Burt and I playing. It was Burt Bacarach and I, yeah. I don’t remember — I think we were both doing the same thing.
